focus: Truck-rental desks inside the city (five Penske locations, including the Roosevelt Blvd Home Depot, and ten company-run U-Haul stores from Center City and South Philadelphia to West Philadelphia, North Philadelphia, and the Northeast), plus two labor-only options
intro: This first Philadelphia page covers truck-rental locations whose official Penske and U-Haul pages list a city address — five Penske desks (Washington Ave, the airport, Port Richmond, Fishtown, and the Roosevelt Blvd Home Depot, the only one open Sunday) and ten company-run U-Haul stores that all publish Sunday hours. Two labor-only options are included for people who already have a truck or container: Bellhop, which lists a South Broad St address, and College HUNKS, whose Philadelphia labor page lists a West Chester office. U-Haul neighborhood dealers, Budget, and Enterprise Truck Rental are not covered yet, and neither are suburbs such as Upper Darby, Cherry Hill, or King of Prussia. Three U-Haul stores say there is no on-site customer parking. We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.name: Bellhop — Philadelphia hourly moving labor

hours.notes: Hours from the visible footer of the official Philadelphia page: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, Sun 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. The page’s structured data lists shorter 8:00 AM–6:00 PM hours, so the two disagree; we copied the visible text. Confirm before you book.

listings.offersNotes: The official Philadelphia page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled Philadelphia movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging.” The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with independent labor and/or transportation providers.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. The page mentions last-minute movers; confirm crew availability for your date.

listings.name: College HUNKS Hauling Junk & Moving — Philadelphia hourly labor
listings.area: Philadelphia area (office in West Chester, PA)

hours.notes: Hours from the official Philadelphia labor page: Monday–Saturday 8:00 am–9:00 pm, Sunday 9:00 am–9:00 pm. The address on that page is in West Chester, PA, outside the city.

listings.offersNotes: The official page says the Philadelphia team offers “labor-only moving services by the hour,” including loading and unloading a moving truck, storage unit, or portable storage container. It says next-day or same-day service is possible in many cases.
listings.visitNotes: The listed service-area towns are mostly Philadelphia’s western and Main Line suburbs; confirm that a crew covers your Philadelphia address.
